text:
deploy-bot: kicking off v2 slice F at 02:10 UTC — progressive ramp 3% -> 10% over 20m. Changes: header normalization + streaming boundary tighten. Pinlists active: tenant-exclude.csv
alex: quick check 1: does v2 change default response envelope for streaming? heard one client proxy unwraps differently.
priya: v2 does not change envelope for streaming, but header key normalization can break some proxies that rely on exact-cased headers.
ops-lee: monitor alert: slice F tenant 'harborbay' 5xx increased to 0.85% at 02:16 UTC. auto-pause thresholds matched.
deploy-bot: slice F paused at 02:17 UTC by auto-pause. traffic reverted to v1 for affected slice.
sam: recommend temporary pin for harborbay and nearby tenants on same proxy path. quick pin API sample:
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"harborbay","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 header normalization proxy regressions","expires":"2026-04-07T00:00:00Z"}'
priya: pin applied; deploy-bot acknowledged in 19s. telemetry shows harborbay 5xx dropped to 0.03% after 3m.
product-zoe: please add a short compatibility blurb to release notes: explain header normalization, how to pin, and SDK version to upgrade to. also include rollback criteria.
ops-lee: rollback criteria reminder: if pinned tenants >8% of canary capacity OR any tenant >1% 5xx for 5m -> schedule rollback window and page oncall. added to incident INC-2026-999.
alex: SDK team will backport a header compatibility shim in 1.4.3. ETA patch + narrow canary in ~2h.
priya: plan: keep affected tenants pinned, cut narrow hotfix canary once patch bakes, notify CS to email impacted customers, update release notes with pin instructions and emergency rollback steps.
product-zoe: thanks — keep this thread live for coordination and final release note signoff. :white_check_mark:
